InvestmentAsset.title: InvestmentAsset
InvestmentAsset.description: A capitalised asset eligible for one or more investeringsaftrek schemes (KIA/EIA/MIA/Vamil) per Wet IB 2001 art. 3.40-3.47. 1-to-1 with FixedAsset (fixedAssetId). Eligibility is classified at capitalisation against the four schemes (REQ-INV-001); the RvO meldingstermijn deadline is derived from opdrachtverleningDatum (REQ-INV-007). Introduced by the bookkeeping-investeringsaftrek change (T4).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this asset for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

fixedAssetId.description: 1-to-1 FK to the FixedAsset this InvestmentAsset overlays (bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation).
fixedAssetId.title: Fixed Asset ID

invoiceNumber.description: Supplier invoice number for audit linkage.
invoiceNumber.title: Factuurnummer

acquisitionDate.description: Invoice/acquisition date. NOT used for the RvO deadline (see opdrachtverleningDatum).
acquisitionDate.title: Aanschafdatum

assignmentAwardDate.description: Date the binding order was placed. Mandatory for EIA/MIA/Vamil assets; the RvO 3-month meldingstermijn runs from this date, NOT the invoice or delivery date (REQ-INV-007).
assignmentAwardDate.title: Opdrachtverlening Datum

commissioningDate.description: Date the asset was taken into use; relevant for Vamil 75%-direct timing.
commissioningDate.title: Ingebruikname Datum

acquisitionValue.description: Acquisition value in minor currency units (EUR cents), excluding recoverable BTW.
acquisitionValue.title: Aanschafwaarde

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. EUR-only in this tier.
currency.title: Valuta

vatRegime.description: BTW handling for the asset (aftrekbaar/niet-aftrekbaar/gemengd); affects the aftrek grondslag.
vatRegime.title: BTW Regime

category.description: Free-text or taxonomy category used for code lookup hints.
category.title: Categorie

energyListCode.description: Matched EnergielijstCode.code (EIA). Resolved against the opdrachtverleningDatum year list (REQ-INV-002).
energyListCode.title: Energielijst Code

environmentListCode.description: Matched MilieulijstCode.code (MIA/Vamil). Resolved against the opdrachtverleningDatum year list (REQ-INV-002).
environmentListCode.title: Milieulijst Code

kiaEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for KIA (computed by the eligibility classifier; operator-overridable).
kiaEligible.title: Kia Eligible

eiaEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for EIA (Energielijst match + EUR 2.5k minimum).
eiaEligible.title: Eia Eligible

miaEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for MIA (Milieulijst match + EUR 2.5k minimum).
miaEligible.title: Mia Eligible

vamilEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for Vamil (Milieulijst + vamilToegestaan + EUR 2.5k minimum).
vamilEligible.title: Vamil Eligible

eligibilityOverride.description: Boekhouder override of the computed classification, per scheme, with a mandatory rationale (REQ-INV-001 / D2).

rationale.example: Niet claimen: asset is geleased, niet in eigendom.
rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: The date and time for rationale.

eligibilityOverride.title: Eligibility Override

rvoReportDate.description: Date the RvO melding was submitted.
rvoReportDate.title: Rvo Melding Datum

rvoReportDeadline.description: Computed deadline = opdrachtverleningDatum + 3 months (REQ-INV-007). Derived by DesinvesteringsbijtellingGuard::computeMeldingDeadline / the calculations engine.
rvoReportDeadline.title: Rvo Melding Deadline

rvoReference.description: RvO eLoket reference once a melding is submitted.
rvoReference.title: Rvo Referentie

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a InvestmentAsset is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

EnergielijstCode.title: EnergielijstCode
EnergielijstCode.description: Reference data: a single RvO Energielijst code (EIA) for a given jaartal. Versioned per year; codes are resolved against the opdrachtverleningDatum year, not the current year (REQ-INV-002). Seeded from lib/Settings/seeds/investeringsaftrek-energielijst-2026.json.

yearNumber.description: List year this code belongs to.
yearNumber.title: Jaartal

category.title: Categorie
category.description: The date and time for categorie.

deelpercentage.description: Percentage of the investment that qualifies (often 100).
deelpercentage.title: Deelpercentage

maxAmountPerUnit.description: Maximum qualifying amount per unit in EUR cents, when capped.
maxAmountPerUnit.title: Max Bedrag Per Eenheid

effectiveDate.title: Ingangsdatum
effectiveDate.description: The date and time for ingangsdatum.

expiryDate.title: Vervaldatum
expiryDate.description: The date and time for vervaldatum.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a EnergielijstCode is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

MilieulijstCode.title: MilieulijstCode
MilieulijstCode.description: Reference data: a single RvO Milieulijst code (MIA/Vamil) for a given jaartal. Carries the MIA percentage (27/36/45) and the vamilToegestaan flag. Versioned per year. Seeded from lib/Settings/seeds/investeringsaftrek-milieulijst-2026.json.

category.title: Categorie
category.description: The date and time for categorie.

vamilPermitted.description: Whether Vamil willekeurige afschrijving is permitted for this code.
vamilPermitted.title: Vamil Toegestaan

maxAmount.description: Maximum qualifying amount in EUR cents, when capped.
maxAmount.title: Max Bedrag

effectiveDate.title: Ingangsdatum
effectiveDate.description: The date and time for ingangsdatum.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a MilieulijstCode is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

InvesteringsaftrekClaim.title: InvesteringsaftrekClaim
InvesteringsaftrekClaim.description: One claim per (asset, scheme, boekjaar) combination. Carries the grondslag, percentage and computed aftrekbedrag, plus the ingediend -> definitief lifecycle and the async RvO beschikking. Vrijwillige verlaging is tracked separately from the legal entitlement (REQ-INV-009). Introduced by bookkeeping-investeringsaftrek.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The date and time for administration id.

financialYear.description: Fiscal year the claim applies to.
financialYear.title: Boekjaar

basis.description: Base amount the percentage applies to, in EUR cents.
basis.title: Grondslag

percentage.description: Applied percentage (e.g. 40 for EIA, 27/36/45 for MIA). Null for KIA (tiered).
percentage.title: Percentage

deductionAmount.description: Computed deduction in EUR cents (after any vrijwillige verlaging).
deductionAmount.title: Aftrekbedrag

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of this record.

submittedInTaxReturn.title: Ingediend In Aangifte
submittedInTaxReturn.description: Indicates whether ngediend in aangifte applies.

rvoDecision.description: RvO award, populated async via the openconnector mededeling feed or overridden by the boekhouder (REQ-INV-007 / D8).

decisionDate.title: Beschikkingsdatum
decisionDate.description: The date and time for beschikkingsdatum.

awardedAmount.title: Toegekend Bedrag
awardedAmount.description: The numeric value for toegekend bedrag.

rvoDecision.title: Rvo Beschikking

voluntaryReduction.description: Voluntary reduction applied to the legal entitlement, in EUR cents (REQ-INV-009). Not carry-forwardable.
voluntaryReduction.title: Vrijwillige Verlaging

verlaginRationale.description: Mandatory rationale when a vrijwillige verlaging is applied.
verlaginRationale.title: Verlagin Rationale

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a InvesteringsaftrekClaim is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

VamilDepreciation.title: VamilDepreciation
VamilDepreciation.description: Willekeurige afschrijving schedule for a Vamil-claimed asset: 75% direct in the year of ingebruikname + 25% via the regular depreciation schedule. Consumed by bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation via the InvestmentAsset relation (REQ-INV-010 / D6).

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The date and time for administration id.

investmentAssetId.title: Investment Asset ID
investmentAssetId.description: The identifier of the associated investment asset.

spreadPart.description: Remaining 25% spread over the regular schedule, in EUR cents.
spreadPart.title: Gespreid Deel

regularDepreciationSchedule.description: The regular schedule for the 25% gespreid deel.

termYears.title: Looptijd Jaren
termYears.description: The numeric value for looptijd jaren.

annualDepreciation.title: Jaarlijkse Afschrijving
annualDepreciation.description: The numeric value for jaarlijkse afschrijving.

regularDepreciationSchedule.title: Regulier Afschrijfschema

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a VamilDepreciation is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

KIATier.title: KIATier
KIATier.description: Reference data: the 2026 KIA tiered lookup table (Wet IB 2001 art. 3.41, geindexeerd). KIA is aggregated at boekjaar level over the running kiaJaartotaal; the tier is resolved by KiaSchalenLookup (ADR-031 exception guard). Seeded from lib/Settings/seeds/investeringsaftrek-kia-tiers-2026.json.

from.description: Lower bound of the tier (inclusive), EUR cents.
from.title: Vanaf

tot.description: Upper bound of the tier (exclusive), EUR cents. Null for the open top tier.
tot.title: Tot

percentage.description: Percentage applied within the tier (28 for tier 2; -7.56 for the tier-4 taper). Null for the flat-amount tier 3.
percentage.title: Percentage

fixedAmount.description: Flat KIA amount for the tier in EUR cents (tier 3/4 anchor). Null where the tier is purely percentage.
fixedAmount.title: Vast Bedrag

rule.description: Human-readable description of the tier rule.
rule.title: Regel

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a KIATier is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).
